title: Direct payment
fundDialogTitle: Accept proposal — pay outside the platform
fundDialogBody: Project value is paid directly between the parties outside the platform. Libyan Freelance does not hold project funds and does not process the transfer.
disputeDialogBody: Describe the issue clearly. Project value is handled directly between the parties outside the platform.
escrowHistorySubtitle: Libyan Freelance does not receive or hold project funds. Payment is arranged directly between client and freelancer. Electronic payments on the platform are for freelancer subscriptions only.
noTransactions: No platform-held project payments — project fees are paid directly between the parties.
directPaymentBanner: Libyan Freelance is an advertising platform and technical intermediary connecting clients with freelancers. The platform does not receive project payment amounts, does not hold parties' funds, and does not guarantee project delivery or payment. Agreement and payment are made directly between the client and the freelancer.
platformPaymentsOnly: Electronic payments inside Libyan Freelance are only for freelancer monthly subscriptions offered by the platform.
